info.title: Laravel AI SDK - API Documentation
info.description: This documentation provides a concise reference for configuring, calling, and extending AI-powered endpoints.

get.description: Check if the Laravel API is running.
Check if the Laravel AI Software Development Kit (SDK) is running.

value.message: AI SDK is fully set up and ready to go.
